scope: Private Web selection/model/reader/table and drawer reuse, release identity and documentation. No API/schema/dependency, persistence, collection, valuation or transaction changes.

runtime.environment: Local Docker only; no production deployment
runtime.status: Server, Web and unchanged quant-engine healthy

ci.scope: Configured quality gates and zero-write backtest regression passed on all three platforms; build on the configured Linux job.

limits: Comparison covers only the captured visible page, not the full watchlist or market. Missing, unavailable, mismatched or suspended rows retain existing restrictions.
Dismissal stops queued requests; up to four already-started reads can finish. This per-comparison worker bound does not cover unrelated existing quote polling or development StrictMode probes.
Existing detail identity metadata can be empty outside the curated samples; the actual daily data remains separately dated and sourced.
Stored historical research only, with no new account/order write or live broker path. No full P6-N02 or phase acceptance; local Chrome evidence is distinct from three-platform source CI.
